evaluation: Original six development chapters, 48 windows / 3024 targets at each sampled cursor. Never rescore the external book or reserve. The original endpoint is already known.
milestone_rule: First sampled post-update cursor with learned4 NLL minus affine NLL > 0.001 for every seed; report all cursors, not an exact onset between them.
residual: Pool actual pre-update sum of squared output-minus-input over sum of squared input within each band/site/seed, then average ratios across seeds. This is element-energy weighted within seed, not an average of per-token ratios.
radius: Report only pooled signed/absolute pre-clip d(loss)/d(log_radius) and negative fraction, never exact individual radii or learned tensors. A fixed or absent radius has no trainable gradient.
acceptance: Every ordinary nested step must match the original public-wheel step bytes; final checkpoint bytes and endpoint development chapter scores must match. Stop on first error, keep partial observations, no retry or tuning.
privacy: Private raw per-site observations, optimizer and token data stay local. Export only the fixed scalar projections, identities and case statuses.
limits: post-hoc localization, not a fresh test of generalization
matched within-seed batches, not a fixed probe batch throughout training
correlation of residual magnitude, gradients and development NLL is not causal attribution
